let Variable = JSON.parse(source.getVariable());

if ( !Variable.Variable.test ) {

    let request_test_url = Variable.Variable.Host + "/yuedu/api/request_test.php";

    try{
	       let res = JSON.parse(java.ajax(request_test_url));
	       if ( res.request.return ) {
	       	    mes = "测试成功！";
	       	} else {
	       		   mes = "测试失败！";
	       	}
	       	Variable.Variable.test = true;
	       	source.setVariable(JSON.stringify(Variable, null, "\t"));
	       	java.log(mes);
	       java.toast(mes);
	    } catch(er) {
		      Variable.Variable.test = true;
	    	   Variable.Variable.Host = "http://xindmian.xuanbao.icu";
		      source.setVariable(JSON.stringify(Variable, null, "\t"));
		      java.log("测试失败：\n" + er);
	    	  java.toast("测试失败，抱歉，你无法使用本源！");
	    	 }
	}
	
let Key = source.getLoginInfoMap().get("在这里填入Key");
